## Cardiometabolic disease and obesity

<!-- PLACEHOLDER: herschrijf in eigen woorden -->
Heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, heart failure and chronic kidney disease share risk factors and drive each other. I study the burden and costs of this cluster in the Netherlands, and how new treatments and care pathways change that picture.

## Health as investment

<!-- PLACEHOLDER -->
Cost-effectiveness ratios tell part of the story. I'm interested in the rest: what better health means for work, productivity and public finances, and how to make that case to payers, ministries and employers.

## PhD

<!-- PLACEHOLDER: controleer status en wat je openbaar wilt maken -->
My PhD work, with the Open Universiteit and Zuyderland Medisch Centrum, focuses on redesigning the care pathway for cardiovascular risk management.
